subject: literacy
concept: Reading and critically evaluating a full persuasive text, applying all rhetoric skills together
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student follows along while reading a full persuasive passage
exercise.abstract: Student reads a persuasive passage, identifies its bias, evaluates its evidence, and states whether the argument is convincing and why

assessment.mastery_threshold: correctly identifies bias, evaluates at least one piece of evidence, and gives a reasoned verdict
misconception_flags: gives a verdict based on personal agreement with the conclusion rather than the argument's actual quality

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
